## How a verdict is reached

Each entry records how its license verdict was reached (`audit.method`):

- `tag`: the publisher's own license tag is on the table and marked for tag use. No person read it. The model page says "license as declared by the publisher".
- `text-hash`: the license text has the same sha256 as a text a person already read.
- `inherited`: the base model has a stricter verdict than the entry, so the base model's verdict applies.
- `reviewed`: a person read this repo's license and recorded the result.
- `queue`: none of the above. The entry is not listed until a person reads the text. Texts are grouped by their sha256, so one decision clears every repo that ships the same text.

The strictest verdict along base model, fine-tune and quantization wins. A quantization of a refused base model is refused, whatever its own tag says. A quantization with no license tag of its own takes its base model's verdict, because a quantizer cannot relicense the weights. A base model that declares no license sends its derivatives to the review queue, not to the refusal log.

## Custom licenses

A custom or community license (for example a model-specific license) is allowed only after:

1. A person reads it once and records the result in the table, with the sha256 of the text.
2. The model page shows a click-through of the license text before download.
3. The license allows redistribution by a third party. If it does not, we link to the source only.

## Non-commercial licenses

Listed with a link to the source only. Freeweights never hosts a copy, and Allternit does not run these models commercially.

## Refusals

- A license on the refused list, a license that excludes where we host from, or no license at all.
- Every refusal is logged: model, source, license found, date and reason. The log is public on the Wanted page.

## Gated repos

A repo behind a login, an access form or an acceptance gate at the source is listed as a link only. We do not copy gated files and we do not bypass a gate. A repo that becomes gated after it was listed becomes link-only on the next sync.

## Rules for every listing

- The license text and a checksum are shown with every file.
- A license change at the source is checked on each sync. A change to a license off the table moves the model to the review queue.

## Open decisions (Allternit)

- Llama community licenses and OpenRAIL licenses: held until counsel reads them.
- Gemma terms: one read by a person, then a rule.
- GPL, LGPL and AGPL for weights, and no-derivatives licenses: held.

## Verify with counsel

- Whether each listed license allows hosting and mirroring of weights as we do it.
- Click-through wording and how we record acceptance without storing personal data.
- Treatment of licenses that cover code and weights differently.
